name: little-logic-lab
description: Evidence-informed, offline-first architecture and content library for logic games ages 2.5–6.

scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @little-logic-lab/web && npm run check:web-build
scripts.test:web:performance: LOGIC_LAB_PERF=1 playwright test --grep "Pixi exposes frame diagnostics" --project chromium-touch --workers=1
scripts.test:web:trace-touch: LOGIC_LAB_TRACE_TOUCH=1 playwright test --grep "trace road follows continuous" --project chromium-touch --workers=1
scripts.test:web:all-games: LOGIC_LAB_ALL_GAMES=1 playwright test --grep "all P0 games reach ready" --project chromium-touch --workers=1
scripts.test: npm run generate:curriculum && npm run generate:ladders && npm run generate:content && npm run validate && npm run validate:audio && npm run validate:audio-packs && npm run check:v2-runtime && npm run policy:check && npm run build && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.generate: npm run generate:curriculum && npm run generate:ladders && npm run generate:content && npm run generate:catalog && npm run preview
